summary: Completed comprehensive testing of JUSTICE platform MVP. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate), frontend UI loads correctly, but critical CORS configuration issue preventing authentication flow.

integration_issues.issue: CORS policy blocking authentication requests - wildcard '*' origin not allowed with credentials
integration_issues.impact: Prevents users from logging in or accessing protected pages
integration_issues.technical_details: Backend CORS config uses allow_origins=['*'] but frontend makes requests with withCredentials=true. This combination is forbidden by CORS policy.

integration_issues.issue: URL mismatch between frontend config and actual backend URL
integration_issues.impact: Frontend trying to access wrong backend URL causing request failures
integration_issues.technical_details: Frontend REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL points to https://police-watch-2.preview.emergentagent.com but requests going to https://police-watch-2.preview.emergentagent.com

passed_tests: Frontend direct API connectivity (health, public analytics)

critical_fixes_required.solution: Change CORS allow_origins from ['*'] to specific frontend URL or configure to allow credentials properly
Ensure REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL matches actual backend deployment URL

action_item_for_main_agent.testing_notes: All backend APIs are working perfectly. Frontend UI renders correctly. The main blocker is CORS configuration preventing authentication flow. Once CORS is fixed, the application should work end-to-end.
